runtime.installation: explicit opt-in download into versioned Application Support directory; never bundled or required by the base product

training_data.license: commercial; exact model metadata states licensed by Explosion
citation only; no ClearNLP code is packaged in the model

lifecycle.activate: set LLPLAYERNEXT_SYNTAX_PYTHON and LLPLAYERNEXT_SYNTAX_SIDECAR to the verified installation paths
lifecycle.refresh: install a newly audited version into a new versioned directory; never mutate a qualified identity in place
lifecycle.uninstall: disable first, then remove only that versioned installation directory

decision: spaCy is qualified as an optional local shared syntax artifact provider. B future/used-to/have-to, SenseGroup, and dependency candidate matching may consume validated artifacts. B want-to remains fallback-only. No runtime/model redistribution is added to the base app.
